card.title: Not Until You Explain
card.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 last bus prompts A3 driving; B4 admits a stop, which A5 makes the next required explanation.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants transport home and B4 partly accounts for the discrepancy, changing A's question.

heightening.evidence: B4 resolves departure time but reveals a stop; A5 uses that omission to extend the conversation.

specificity.evidence: A1 timed taxi receipt and B2 last bus supply concrete evidence and immediate departure pressure.
